Scientists agree that the Earth's average temperature has increased by about 1.8°F over the past 200 years. It may not sound like big change, but it will influence the earth. A greenhouse is glass-covered building that absorbs the heat from the sun it is usually very hot. Of course, the earth is not covered with glass but greenhouse effect refers to retention of the sun's warmth in the earth's lower atmosphere by greenhouse gases. The greenhouse gases include mostly carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide. These gases (instead of glass) act as blanket for earth, helping to keep the earth warm enough to support life at an average temperature of about 50°F.
